updates.title: Downtown Bank
updates.summary: A new big score job is up on the whiteboards: the City Savings Bank downtown. The pawn shop and the diner got overhauled, Night School has four new courses and there are two new kits in The Back Room.
added: City Savings Bank, a 4 star big score downtown with a $40,000 goal. It needs the Big Score contract
Two night guards walk the bank with radios, and if they spot you they call it in
The vault takes the manager's keycard and then a code. Lasers sweep and blink down the vault hallway
A CCTV office behind a keypad door, with kill switches for the cameras and the lasers on the console
Bank loot: gold stacks behind a gate you pick open, cash bricks, jewelry in deposit boxes you pick open, and the computers and monitors off the desks
Night School has four new courses: Nimble Fingers, Fence Contacts, Slow Response and Glass Work

Two kits in the Contracts tab of The Back Room. Side Hustle is the Delivery Truck key, the Uptown Jobs contract and $10,000 for 1,100 credits. The Big Haul is the Flatbed Truck key, the Big Score contract and $50,000 for 2,700 credits
changed: The pawn shop is a bigger corner shop on a new city street. It has a basement with a keypad vault, a workshop, an office and a CCTV room with a camera kill switch. The vault code is written down somewhere in the shop

The diner got a basement with a cash room behind an old brass key that turns up in one of five spots, a big safe in the office and five night deposit bags. The dining room, kitchen and lot are redone and the gas station is gone
The mansion lasers move now. The low beam blinks and the middle one sweeps
Intel is free twice after a run, then costs $250 and doubles each time up to $16,000
The ladder reaches about 6.5m, high enough for the bank's upstairs windows
Blending In slows a cop spotting you up close too, not just from far away
The box trucks and semis got redone grilles, frames and trailer doors
fixed: The wrench didn't work on any map. It works everywhere again
The loading ramp didn't work at the diner. It does now
Cops could tase you through walls. They have to actually see you now
Knocked out cops sometimes got back up. They stay down like they're supposed to
Deadlift Camp and Shot Put homework couldn't be finished. They can now
From some rooms the night sky disappeared
The buy and put on buttons hung off the bottom of the shop info note. They sit on the paper now
Some surfaces flickered on Quest. They stay put now

updates.title: 24 Hour Diner
updates.summary: A new uptown job is up on the whiteboards: the 24 Hour Diner out on the highway. There's also a loading ramp for your getaway, a much roomier Old RV, and more stuff knocks people out.
added: 24 Hour Diner, a 3 star smash and grab that needs the Uptown contract. A chrome dining car with booths and a counter, a kitchen line, restrooms, a storage room and an office, with a truck lot and a closed gas station out on the highway
A cook works the grill and a waitress works the floor on the night shift. Both go out back for smokes, and if they spot you they phone the cops
Diner loot: a cash register, a coffee brewer, a milkshake mixer, a deep fryer, the neon sign out of the window and a commercial toilet you can rip out
Loading Ramp in the gear shop for $25,000. Carry it to the back of the getaway and it folds out down to the ground, tailgates drop for it, so you can walk heavy stuff up instead of lifting it
changed: The Old RV is gutted from behind the cab seats back to the ramp door, so it actually holds more than the ambulance and the delivery truck like the rides board says
More stuff knocks people out. Dumbbells, kettlebells and gold bars do it in one hit, bottles, guitars, kettles and that kind of thing in two
Mansion loot is worth a lot less. Gold bars are $5,000, the grand piano $40,000 and the old master $30,000. A full clear was paying way too much
fixed: The mansion guard slid through the floor on his way to the basement. He walks down like he's supposed to now
NPCs stopped to open doors they weren't even going through. They only stop for a door they're walking through now
The Cedar back door hit the plant, and Maple and Cabin doors swung into the wall and furniture. They stop before them now

updates.title: Playtest Fixes
updates.summary: Changes from your playtest feedback, plus fixes.
changed: Anyone in the crew who isn't locked up can hit the getaway button now, not just the crew leader
The duffel bag takes loot up to 25kg now, so gold bars, typewriters, dumbbells and guitar amps go in. In VR you can drop a heavy carry straight into it. The loot sack still takes up to 10kg
Residents and guards close doors you left open when they walk past
The mansion front door is a big pair of double doors that swing out onto the porch. One lock holds both, and a click throws them all the way open so the grand piano fits through
fixed: On desktop, holding the click on the glass cutter didn't cut a locked window. It cuts like it's supposed to now
Some gear waiting in storage kept falling out of the world and respawning over and over the whole session, which kept the network busy for whoever owned it

updates.title: Glass Cutter Fix
fixed: The glass cutter didn't work on any window on any map. It works everywhere again, the mansion too
The mansion guard said he had someone in the pawn shop when he radioed it in. He says the mansion now

updates.title: Hilltop Mansion
updates.summary: A new big score job is up on the whiteboards: the Hilltop Mansion. There's a new top ride to haul it all, job contracts, paint jobs for your rides and a VR hotbar.
added: Hilltop Mansion, a 4 star big score. Two floors plus a basement with a wine cellar, a security room and a vault, a garage, a pool, a fountain out front and a long drive up the hill
A rich couple sleeps upstairs and a guard walks his rounds. Tripwire lasers in the basement make a racket when you cross them, and they go dark when you cut the power at the breaker
The vault door opens with a colored keycard. One is hidden somewhere in the house every run, so find the one that matches the reader
Big score loot: gold bars, an old master and two more paintings, a marble bust, an ancient urn, vintage wine, whiskey decanters, a jeweled goblet, a grand piano and a motorbike
Flatbed Truck, the new top ride. A semi pulling an open flatbed trailer with 6 gear slots and no weight limit. $600,000 or 2,000 credits

Job contracts. A new board next to the jobs board sells Uptown Jobs for $40,000 and Big Score for $150,000, or 500 and 1,000 credits. The crew leader's contracts decide which jobs come up, and your contact takes a cut of the haul, 5% on Uptown and 15% on Big Score
Paint jobs. Six paints for your rides on their own tab on the shop board, or all six together. The getaway wears your paint when you lead the crew
VR hotbar. Turn it on in the tab menu settings and your belt slots float low in front of you. Point at one and click and the item floats into your hand
The tab menu has a crew strip with a Ready up button, so you don't have to walk over to the plan board
Menus and boards make sounds now, a click on buttons and a page flip on tabs and page buttons
changed: Second Chance Pawn is an Uptown job now and needs the Uptown contract. Maple Street, Cedar Bungalow and Lakeside Cabin stay free
Windows have a new latch and sills, and from inside you can click the glass to unlock them
The cop van has barred windows you can actually see out of, a push bar on the bumper and headlights that light up
The gear page in the tab menu shows your loadout slots
fixed: In VR, grabbing a window or walking past one could break the glass. You have to swing a closed fist into it now
Loot could spawn inside the Cedar Bungalow chimney or under the TV

updates.title: Board Fixes
updates.summary: Small fixes for the hideout boards.
changed: The supporters list on the shop board is two columns now and scrolls round on a loop instead of rewinding back to the top
fixed: Names on the supporters list ran off the bottom of the paper
Gear prices like 4 for $1,000 didn't fit inside their circle on the gear board
The Or credits button on the rides board sat on top of the You ride note

updates.title: Cops and Cases
updates.summary: More pawn shop fixes, and the cops are a lot better at getting around.
added: The pawn shop cases have ring trays and necklace busts in them now, and you can take them
changed: Cops search the house properly now. They go from room to room instead of standing around or wandering back and forth
fixed: In VR you couldn't grab stuff out of a pawn shop case you had just smashed yourself
You could grab loot through the pawn shop walls from outside
Respawning during a job sent you back to the hideout. It puts you back at the house now
Cops walked through parked cars, open doors and the getaway board
For other players, cops could look like they walked through walls
You could walk straight through the parked cars, bins and bench outside the pawn shop

updates.title: Bags and Bolts
updates.summary: Fixes for the pawn shop update. Bags work on every map now, bolted down stuff actually comes loose, and you can see how close it is.
added: Hitting something bolted down shows a ring for how close it is to coming loose
In VR, bringing a hammer or the wrench close to something bolted down shows a Bolted down tag over it
fixed: Duffel bags and loot sacks wouldn't take loot on Maple Street or at the pawn shop. They work on every map now
Once one bolted down thing ripped free, nothing else bolted down in that house could be hit for the rest of the session
Hammer swings in VR only counted the first hit on big bolted things like the AC unit
The pawn shop guard dropped through the floor when he came back down from upstairs. He takes the stairs now
You could walk into the buildings next to the pawn shop and fall out of the map

updates.title: Second Chance Pawn
updates.summary: A new job is up on the whiteboards: Second Chance Pawn, a corner pawn shop on a little high street. Five new tools are in the gear shop too.
added: Second Chance Pawn, a 3 star smash and grab. Glass cases full of jewellery and watches, a guitar wall, an arcade corner, a stock room, an office and storage upstairs, and a back alley with a fire escape

The shop has a roller shutter you raise with a switch inside, an old bell alarm that goes off on any break and calls the cops, and a night guard who walks his rounds and radios it in. The cops take longer to show up here
14 new loot pieces from the pawn shop, like guitars, an amp, a trumpet, a sax, a turntable, a jukebox and an arcade cabinet
Wrench. Hold it on something bolted down and it unbolts it slowly and quietly, instead of the loud rip you get with the hammer
Ladder. Aim at a wall and a ghost shows where it goes, click and it opens out to reach there, then climb it
Appraiser 3000. Point it at loot and pull the trigger and a screen pops up with its name and price
Lamp Disguise. Wear the lampshade and keep still for two seconds, and residents, guards and cameras look right past you
Glass Cutter. Stick it on a locked window and wind it round. It quietly cuts a hole so you can reach in and undo the latch. On desktop hold left click on it, in VR it winds itself
changed: Perks are a lot weaker. Running Away 101 had you sprinting way too fast in VR, and the jump and carry perks were too strong as well
fixed: Only the crew leader could knock out residents and guards. Everyone in the crew can now
The spotted warning only showed for the crew leader when a resident ran off to call the cops
VR players could shove other people's loot around for a moment when grabbing it or bumping into it

updates.title: First release
updates.summary: Break-n-Haul is out. Get a crew of up to 4 together, pick a house off the whiteboards, break in, haul the loot out to your ride and get away before the cops show up.
added: Three houses to rob: Maple Street, Cedar Bungalow and the Lakeside Cabin. Each one has its own street, its own residents and its own security, and the loot, doors and windows change every run
Small loot goes in your hands or your bag. Big stuff like TVs and microwaves slows you down, and the heaviest things need two people to carry
Loot Sack and Duffel Bag. They hold small loot and get heavier as you fill them
Lots of ways in: pick locks, smash windows, slide them open from inside, or climb drainpipes, ledges and trellises to get in upstairs
Residents sleep until something wakes them up. They come and check on noise and call the cops if they catch you
Security cameras that set off the alarm. Knock them down or cut the power at the breaker box
Cops show up, chase you down and lock you in the back of the van. Your crew can break you out
Seven getaway rides, from the Basket Bike up to the Cargo Truck. Bigger rides carry more but the driver takes a bigger cut
Gear shop with lockpicks, bags, a hammer, a flashlight and a head lamp
Night School. Pick a major, take courses, do the homework on jobs and graduate for perks
The Back Room. Gear skins, Supporter and Crew Tags, Double Pay, Crew Boost, ride keys, Hall Pass and Double Major
Your cash, gear, rides and school progress save between visits
Hold Tab on desktop or push the right stick up in VR for the menu with your gear and settings
The haul board shows your waiting boosts and a receipt of your last job with every bonus on it
This board, up on the catwalk over the hideout boards. It shows what changed in every update
